table_grains.dim_date: one row per UTC calendar date observed across timestamped source events
table_grains.dim_route: one row per unique origin_warehouse_id and destination_warehouse_id pair
table_grains.fact_demand: one row per unique demand event_id
table_grains.fact_inventory: one row per unique inventory event_id
table_grains.fact_shipment: one row per shipment record per source file; dispatch and update records remain separate
table_grains.fact_telemetry: one row per unique telemetry event_id, enriched from ground_truth by event_id when matched
table_grains.fact_vehicle_status: one row per unique vehicle-status event_id
table_grains.reference_ground_truth: one row per unique ground-truth event_id; reference/validation data, not an operational fact

note: CSV outputs only; source files were not modified. Null foreign keys indicate missing dimension matches.
